data.description: Design Corner. Here we made our own obstacles for the VEX Robot.

The VEX IQ Robot getting to grips with some our home made obstacles. We did have a go at detecting the colour of the barrels with the Robot's colour sensor, however, we quickly learned that it was best at detecting bright primary colours.
The VEX IQ Robot. Programmed with a block programming application, similar to Scratch.
We had a range of activities, including Scratch, BBC Micro BIT, Raspberry Pi and also the VEX Mod Kit programming application, seen here opposite our Robot.
Some of our members are very enthusiastic about the BBC MicroBIT. We are now starting to use some of the more advanced sensors.
Some of our members are budding games programmers and are now incorporating text to speech within their creations.
Scratch is still very popular and we learn lots by tinkering with re-mixed code and classics such as Flappy Parrot.
